{{Top}}
[[File:DookuFA4PilotDroid-TCWIV.png|thumb|right|300px|Count Dooku's FA-4 pilot droid]]
{{Quote|Flying is for droids.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Pilot droids''' were [[Class five droid/Legends|class five droid]]s used to pilot [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]]. Unlike [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], which were mostly concerned with repair and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] navigation for ships without [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]], pilot droids were used primarily to fly vessels in normal space.<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> While primarily fifth-degree droids, some pilot droids were considered [[Class two droid/Legends|class two droid]]s, such as the [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] made extensive use of [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|pilot battle droids]] originally developed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. In addition to flying [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]], some of these pilot droids were used as part of CIS boarding parties or to pilot ground vehicles. Confederacy leader, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], utilized an [[FA-4 pilot droid/Legends|FA-4 pilot droid]] to pilot [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|his personal]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]].

The FA-4 was a wheeled pilot droid manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and other developed planets, pilot droids often worked in partnership with [[FA-5 valet droid/Legends|FA-5 valet droids]], which escorted passengers to and from Sorosuub [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].

Later, both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used pilot droids such as the [[V1 pilot droid]]. Unlike the pilot droids of the Clone Wars, these droids were unarmed and not designed for combat operations. The Alliance found them too expensive to purchase, though they gladly accepted donated droids or droids stolen from the Empire.<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', the OOM pilot droid is shown as a [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|OOM-series battle droid]] with no markings, while the [[Assault battle droid|Demolitions battle droid]] is shown as a pilot with blue markings.

In [[Star Wars: Battlefront II]] Pilot Droids could only be used in Space Battles.
